description: Follow-up runs: (1) local roughness in the smooth phase, (2) L=6 near the edge of the smooth phase incl. a degenerate start, (3) N_s=4 free massless scalars acting back (S_phi = 1/2 sum_ij W_ij (phi_i-phi_j)^2, W_ij = V_ij/q_ij, V_ij = sum_s V_s/10; exact heat bath per vertex each sweep, zero mode removed by subtracting each field's mean after every sweep; dS_phi included in every edge Metropolis step and in the global dilation, S_phi -> s S_phi), (4) time slicing: freeze=1 fixes edges along e_0 alone at q=1, freeze=2 fixes all edges whose step set contains axis 0 at their flat values; the global dilation is switched off in frozen runs (pure single-edge Metropolis on the free edges, exact detailed balance). Same analysis conventions as results.json (blocking errors; plateau=False means error likely underestimated).
